test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition/prepositional phrase in the following sentence.

_________ some pain in his belly, he could not go to the office the day before yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**' i.e. **Owing to**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"Owing to"** is used to indicate a reason or cause for something.
 
• The sentence discusses the reason why someone could not go to the office, which was due to pain in the belly.
